subject: biology
title: Changes of Puberty
welcome_lead: Discover the changes happening to bodies between childhood and adulthood.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on the changes of puberty and hormones.
final_note: You now know the main changes of puberty and the hormones behind them.

concepts.def: Changes from child to adult body.
Fast growth in height and weight.
Stage of growing into an adult.

walkthroughs.body_html: Puberty is controlled by hormones. Testosterone drives male changes; oestrogen drives female changes. Both bring growth spurts.
Voice deepens, body hair grows, shoulders widen, sperm production begins. Skin can become oilier. These changes can begin between 10 and 15 years old.
Hips widen, breasts develop, body hair grows, menstruation (periods) begin. Skin changes are also common. Changes usually start a little earlier than in boys.
